historical_failure_rows.Description: CMake and Ninja absent from PATH; machine-wide silent installer stalled
historical_failure_rows.Likely cause: Missing user build tools and MSI stall
historical_failure_rows.Next action: Stopped winget route; installed user-local CMake 4.4.0/Ninja 1.13.0 and verified versions

historical_failure_rows.Description: First CMake invocation could not find MSVC because cmd expanded PATH before VsDevCmd updated it
historical_failure_rows.Likely cause: Command expansion order erased compiler PATH entries
historical_failure_rows.Next action: Prepend user tools before calling VsDevCmd; fresh configure detected MSVC 19.51

historical_failure_rows.Description: Two quantization tests segfaulted on TQ3_0 and then one failed its numeric gate
historical_failure_rows.Likely cause: Generic tests called absent optional vec-dot trait; new 3-bit type omitted from existing 3-bit RMSE category
historical_failure_rows.Next action: Added test-only capability guards and mapped TQ3_0 to unchanged 0.0040 3-bit limit; full suite passed 40/40

historical_failure_rows.Description: One controller invocation ran CTest from source root and found zero tests
historical_failure_rows.Next action: Rejected invalid zero-test result; reran with `--test-dir build-cpu-controlled`, parsed exactly 40/40

historical_failure_rows.Description: SYCL Level Zero tests aborted during teardown with device-lost errors
historical_failure_rows.Likely cause: Level Zero runtime instability on the installed Intel UHD driver
historical_failure_rows.Next action: Selected the independently inventoried OpenCL SYCL device; final terminal reconciliation is 40/40

historical_failure_rows.Description: SYCL F16 EXP backend cases returned invalid numeric results
historical_failure_rows.Likely cause: Backend declared unsupported behavior as supported
historical_failure_rows.Next action: Restricted SYCL EXP support to verified F32; targeted regression and terminal suite passed

historical_failure_rows.Description: Thread-safety test exhausted OpenCL resources when run immediately after exhaustive backend operations
historical_failure_rows.Next action: Preserved failed attempt and reran the exact indexed test in isolation; terminal pass included in 40/40 reconciliation

historical_failure_rows.Description: 8B model loads crossed 3 GiB, 2.5 GiB and final 2 GiB emergency floors before a request
historical_failure_rows.Likely cause: 16 GB system cannot preserve the controlled reserve with these 8B mappings
historical_failure_rows.Next action: Stopped and cleaned every process tree; classified both rows from measured gate evidence without unsafe lowering

historical_failure_rows.Description: Initial SYCL TQ3 attempts produced invalid/aborted attention paths
historical_failure_rows.Likely cause: Broad GPU placement was not viable; narrowed placement retained KV and 40/41 layers on CPU
historical_failure_rows.Next action: Recovered with controlled `-ngl 1` placement; accepted three samples and six quality records without claiming GPU-resident TQ3 cache
historical_failure_rows.Resolved?: Yes - recovered with bounded partial placement

historical_failure_rows.Description: Guarded 8B SYCL pilot crossed the unchanged 2048 MiB available-RAM floor before request
historical_failure_rows.Likely cause: 9.35 GB model mapping on a 16 GB shared-memory system exhausted the controlled reserve
historical_failure_rows.Next action: Controller stopped synchronously; schema-v2 preflight, wrapper and post-stop cleanup prove zero residual processes; no quality run

historical_failure_rows.Description: First 16K long-context attempt reached the 900-second absolute deadline
historical_failure_rows.Likely cause: Q8_0 CPU prefill exceeded the initial bounded deadline
historical_failure_rows.Next action: Preserved empty-response hash and reran P5 only with a 1,800-second ceiling; completed in 1,024.6 seconds
